summary: The submitted Software Test Document (STD) for the QueueBoard project follows the required structure. However, the mandatory section 1.2 Test Approach contains only a placeholder rather than the required substantive description.

findings.issue: Section 1.2 Test Approach contains a placeholder instead of a substantive description of the planned example checks.
findings.requirement: The section named "1.2 Test Approach" MUST appear as a BODY heading with a substantive description of the planned example checks; a Table of Contents entry does not satisfy the body requirement.

suggestedAction: Replace the placeholder text in section 1.2 Test Approach with a substantive description of the planned example checks as required by the deliverable instructions.
